recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait-first parkour game called `Parkour.exe: Rizzline Rooftops`. Preserve an endless one-button runner loop: the player starts a run, taps/clicks/presses Space or ArrowUp to jump only while grounded, gravity returns them to the ground, obstacles scroll from right to left and cause immediate game over on rectangle collision, collectibles scroll in similar lanes and add 5 points on rectangle collision, speed increases over time, and restart resets score and entities.

Rebuild the presentation as a satirical vaporwave Y2K internet parkour platformer. The central character is `RIZZ.RUNNER_2K`, an anonymous anime-visor rooftop runner with neon sneakers and a cursor-like trail. Hazards are pop-up ad barricades and glitch browser windows. Rewards are `EZ +5` clout tokens. The HUD should use short readable mobile copy such as `Rizz Score`, `Tap / Space to Vault`, `EZ Clap +5`, and `404 Form Check`.

Use plain HTML/CSS/Canvas/JavaScript, inline when feasible. Use procedural art for skyline, synth sun, rooftop grid, CRT scanlines, player, hazards, rewards, particles, and overlays. Use approved catalog fonts Audiowide and Orbitron. Keep all controls and CTAs touch-friendly in a 390x780-style mobile viewport. Do not add double jump, attacks, lane changes, health, shops, or new scoring rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is an endless one-button canvas runner. The player object sits near the left edge, jumps only while grounded, is pulled by gravity, lands on a fixed ground plane, and collides with right-to-left spawned objects. Obstacles end the run on AABB contact. Collectibles add 5 points on AABB contact. Speed increases over time. Start, game-over, final score, and restart are the only core states.

## Remixed game
`Parkour.exe: Rizzline Rooftops` keeps the same one-thumb jump timing and obstacle-avoidance loop, but reframes it as a vaporwave Y2K internet parkour game. The player is `RIZZ.RUNNER_2K`, an anonymous anime-visor rooftop runner vaulting pop-up ad barricades and collecting `EZ +5` clout tokens across a procedural synth skyline.

## Protected mechanics
- One tap/click/Space/ArrowUp jump, grounded-only.
- Gravity, vertical velocity, ground clamp, and endless requestAnimationFrame loop.
- Right-to-left obstacle and reward spawn cadence.
- AABB collision for fail and pickup.
- +5 score per pickup.
- Timed speed escalation.
- Fail overlay with final score and restart.

## Safe transform surfaces
HUD copy, title, focal avatar drawing, hazard/reward drawing, background, particles, feedback language, fonts, palette, CSS overlays, and small state-feedback media were safe to transform.
